name: mk-background-vertical
title: Soft Backdrop (vertical)
description: Vertical soft-blob backdrop: a muted red and a grey glow (brand 24 % and 20 %) drift slowly over the brand ground, from the first frame when it starts at 0. Placement full fills the frame; top or bottom makes it a rounded 780x652 card with the rest transparent. Lives 180 s, so one mount covers a whole reel; cues set fade-in and fade-out; holds.
